title: Completion records where it happened and travels across the organization
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test.
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Complete a service at one location (including 'Completed elsewhere' naming another shop).
  2. Confirm the completion records where it happened.
  3. At another location, confirm the unit's schedule has advanced.
  4. Confirm the system does not try to detect work done elsewhere.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Completion records where it happened, including another shop.
  • Completion travels across the organization: a unit serviced at one location advances what another location tracks.
  • The system cannot detect work done elsewhere and does not try; the reminder is what prompts the customer to mention it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S18-R12: “Completion travels across the organization. A unit serviced at one location advances what another location tracks”
